summary: Frontend-only brand-alignment + pack-reveal animation regression (iteration 5). ALL 5 spec bullets PASS visually and functionally. (1) /play-trade: PageShell 'PLAY & TRADE' gradient title, pack-demo-section rendered with 'PACK READY' state, cosmic dark theme + glass cards confirmed. (2) Pack-opening animation: clicking data-testid=open-pack-cta triggered burst -> sequentially revealed all 5 cards (card-reveal-0..4), ended in 'done' state with VIEW IN COLLECTION link (data-testid=reveal-view-collection) and TRY ANOTHER PACK reset button (data-testid=pack-demo-reset) that successfully returns pack to 'PACK READY'. Best-pull banner did not appear this run (roll was Common+Rare, banner is Epic/Legendary only — acceptable per spec). Full reveal completes within ~4-5s as required. (3) /packs (client-gated): after injecting localStorage.user + gachard_uid cookie, page rendered PageShell header 'CHOOSE YOUR PACK', both PackCards (pack-card-standard, pack-card-booster) with fanned card-stack visuals, stat blocks (5 cards / 1 rare+, 10 cards / 2 rare+), BUY & OPEN buttons (pack-buy-standard, pack-buy-booster), 500/800 CREDIT price, and 'DROP RATES' legend below. Emoji scan on pack cards returned an empty array — NO emoji present, per spec. (4) /profile: PageShell 'PROFILE' gradient header, identity card @CosmicPlayer + demo@gachard.io, Credit Balance card with TOP UP CTA, Collection Stats block with new Rarity Mix distribution bar (data-testid=profile-rarity-bar) + Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary legend, Redeem A Physical Card card, and empty-state 'OPEN FIRST PACK' CTA all visible. (5) /admin (HTTP Basic admin:gachard123): PageShell 'CONTROL ROOM / ADMIN CONSOLE' gradient header, all four summary cards (admin-summary-users/transactions/cards/pending-prints) render with pill styling, all four pill tabs with icons (admin-tab-users/transactions/cards/prints) present and switch dataset cleanly on click, admin-refresh button present and clickable, glass table with 'No … found' empty state renders for every tab. NOTE: Admin API endpoints return HTTP 502 via the preview host ingress but return HTTP 200 via localhost:3000 — this is an ingress/Basic-Auth-forwarding issue, not a frontend code bug, and the admin UI handles it gracefully by showing an inline 'HTTP 502' error banner while still rendering the empty tables.

UI handles it gracefully with an inline error banner + empty table. Out of scope for frontend testing per review-request note, but flagged for main agent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 verified brand alignment for /packs, /play-trade, /profile, /admin and the new dramatic pack-reveal animation on /play-trade (PackDemo component). All required data-testids resolve, all four pages render on-brand (dark cosmic, aurora gradients, glass surfaces, PageShell headers). Only outstanding note: /api/admin/* returns 502 via preview host ingress (works via localhost) — pre-existing infra concern, admin UI degrades gracefully.
rca of the issue: Admin API 502 via preview host: request works on http://localhost:3000/api/admin/users (200) with same Basic auth, but preview host returns 502. Root cause is at the Kubernetes ingress layer — most likely (a) Authorization: Basic header is being stripped/altered by the ingress, or (b) the upstream Next.js route handler is exceeding the ingress read-timeout while waiting on MongoDB. Frontend code is not at fault. Mitigation for main agent: configure ingress to preserve the Authorization header for /api/admin/*, or switch admin auth to a token/session cookie instead of HTTP Basic which is fragile behind proxies.
